title: The Price of Peace
summary: Five years later, the world has flourished beyond imagination. Kang Tae-Jun and Ha-Jun preside over the opening of the Kang International Academy, celebrating the permanent harvest of their sacrifices.

panels.shot: grand panoramic view of new seoul five years later
panels.setting: new seoul five years later wide
panels.action: Five years into the future: a sparkling metropolis of solar skyscrapers, sky gardens, and peaceful interdimensional transit portals.

dialogue.text: FIVE YEARS LATER.

panels.prose_en: Five years into the future: a sparkling metropolis of solar skyscrapers, sky gardens, and peaceful interdimensional transit portals.
panels.prose_hi: Bhavishya mein paanch sal: saur gaganchumbi imaraton, aakash udyanon aur shantipurna antar-aayami pargaman portalon ka ek shandar mahanagar.

panels.shot: the grand entrance gates of the kang academy of coexistence
panels.action: A breathtaking architectural marvel: high neoclassical stone arches entwined with living golden vines and purple roses.

dialogue.text: THE KANG ACADEMY OF INTERDIMENSIONAL HARMONY.

panels.prose_en: A breathtaking architectural marvel: high neoclassical stone arches entwined with living golden vines and purple roses.
panels.prose_hi: Ek lubhavani vastushilp chamatkar: oonche neoclassical patthar ke mehrab jo jeevit sunhari lataon aur baingani gulabon se jude hue han.

panels.shot: in the center of the courtyard: a life-sized bronze statue of the two brothers
panels.action: A magnificent bronze monument depicting Kang Tae-Jun holding his Guardian Shield and Kang Ha-Jun with his starlight wings.
panels.prose_en: A magnificent bronze monument depicting Kang Tae-Jun holding his Guardian Shield and Kang Ha-Jun with his starlight wings.
panels.prose_hi: Ek shandar kansya smarak jisme kang taaye-jun ko apne sanrakshak shield aur kang ha-jun ko apne taron wale pankhon ke saath dikhaya gaya hai.

panels.shot: engraved at the base of the statue: 'neither shall walk alone'
panels.action: The plaque reads in both Korean and Demonic: 'BROTHERS IN BLOOD, GUARDIANS OF TOMORROW. NEITHER SHALL WALK ALONE.'
panels.prose_en: The plaque reads in both Korean and Demonic: 'BROTHERS IN BLOOD, GUARDIANS OF TOMORROW. NEITHER SHALL WALK ALONE.'.
panels.prose_hi: Pattika par korean aur rakshasi donon bhashaon mein likha hai: 'rakt mein bhai, kal ke sanrshak. na to akele chalenge.'

panels.shot: 25-year-old kang tae-jun in dean's dark formal suit and bronze pin
panels.action: Kang Tae-Jun—now 25, broad-shouldered, dignified, wearing a tailored charcoal suit and gold glasses—inspects the courtyard.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Ceremony preparations look flawless, General.

panels.prose_en: Kang Tae-Jun—now 25, broad-shouldered, dignified, wearing a tailored charcoal suit and gold glasses—inspects the courtyard.
panels.prose_hi: Cong taaye-jun - jo ab 25 varsh ka hai, chaude kandhe wala, pratishthit, silvaya hua charcoal suit aur sone ka chashma pahane hue - aangan ka nirikshan karta hai.

panels.shot: general baek now retired with white hair in a sharp civilian blazer
panels.action: Baek, now with dignified white hair at his temples, smiles warmly: 'The first graduating class of five hundred humans and demons.'

dialogue.speaker: baek
dialogue.text: Five hundred graduates entering world leadership today.

panels.prose_en: Baek, now with dignified white hair at his temples, smiles warmly: 'The first graduating class of five hundred humans and demons.'.
panels.prose_hi: Bek, ab apni kanpati par sammanjanak safed baalon ke sath, garmjoshi se muskurate han: 'panch sau manushyon aur rakshason ka pehla snatak varg.'

panels.shot: min-jae rushing across the lawn holding holographic tablets
panels.action: Min-Jae—now Chief Administrative Officer in a sharp three-piece suit—runs up, adjusting glasses: 'Diplomats from 80 nations have arrived!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: The auditorium is packed to maximum capacity! Where is Ha-Jun?!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae—now Chief Administrative Officer in a sharp three-piece suit—runs up, adjusting glasses: 'Diplomats from 80 nations have arrived!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-jaye-ab mukhya prashasnik adhikari ek tez thri-pis suit men-chashma theek karte hue daudte han: '80 deshon ke rajnayik aa gaye han!'

panels.shot: tae-jun chuckling looking up toward the library roof
panels.action: Tae-Jun chuckles: 'Where do you think he is? He's on the roof watching the clouds.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: He never changes.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun chuckles: 'Where do you think he is? He's on the roof watching the clouds.'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun hanste hue kahte han: 'tumhen kya lagta hai wah kahan hai? wah chhat par baadalon ko dekh raha hai.'

panels.shot: on the quiet library roof: 22-year-old ha-jun kang leaning against the railing
panels.setting: ha-jun on roof five years later
panels.action: 22-year-old Ha-Jun Kang—mature, tall, breathtakingly handsome in a simple black button-down shirt and jeans—looks at the sky.
panels.prose_en: 22-year-old Ha-Jun Kang—mature, tall, breathtakingly handsome in a simple black button-down shirt and jeans—looks at the sky.
panels.prose_hi: 22 varshiya ha-jun kang - ek sadharan kali batan-down shirt aur jeans mein paripakv, lamba, lubhavani roop se sundar - aakash ki or dekh raha hai.

panels.shot: kuro perched on his shoulder, shiny and sleek, wearing a miniature gold chain
panels.action: Kuro sits proudly on his shoulder, preening his feathers: 'They are waiting for your keynote speech, My Sovereign.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Don't make your brother wait too long.

panels.prose_en: Kuro sits proudly on his shoulder, preening his feathers: 'They are waiting for your keynote speech, My Sovereign.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro garv se apne kandhe par baithta hai, apne pankh failata hai: 've aapke mukhya bhashan ki pratiksha kar rahe han, mere prabhu.'

panels.shot: ha-jun smiling warmly reaching into his pocket for a warm canned coffee
panels.action: Ha-Jun pops the tab of his coffee can: 'Two minutes, Kuro. I just wanted to feel the breeze.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Bas do minute. The air is so sweet today.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun pops the tab of his coffee can: 'Two minutes, Kuro. I just wanted to feel the breeze.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apne coffee can ka tab kholta hai: 'do minut, kuro. main bus hawa ka jhonka mahsoos karna chahta tha.'

panels.shot: tae-jun stepping out onto the rooftop door joining ha-jun by the railing
panels.action: Tae-Jun walks onto the terrace, resting his forearms on the stone balustrade beside Ha-Jun.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Penny for your thoughts, Professor Kang?

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun walks onto the terrace, resting his forearms on the stone balustrade beside Ha-Jun.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun chhat par chalta hai, apne agrabahuon ko ha-jun ke bagal mein patthar ke chhajje par tikata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking at tae-jun with deep, peaceful love
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks at his brother: 'I was thinking about the day you caught me falling from the clouds in Chapter 86.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Aapne mujhe girne se bacha liya tha.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks at his brother: 'I was thinking about the day you caught me falling from the clouds in Chapter 86.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apne bhai ki or dekhta hai: 'main us din ke baare mein soch raha tha jab tumne adhyay 86 mein mujhe baadalon se girte hue dekha tha.'

panels.shot: tae-jun smiling softly placing his hand over ha-jun hand
panels.action: Tae-Jun covers Ha-Jun's hand: 'And you caught the whole world from falling. That makes us even.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Hum barabar hain.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun covers Ha-Jun's hand: 'And you caught the whole world from falling. That makes us even.'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun ne ha-jun ka haath dhak diya: 'aur aapne puri duniya ko girne se bacha liya. yah hamen sam banata hai.'

panels.shot: down in the courtyard: graduation music begins playing softly
panels.action: Pomp and Circumstance chimes softly from the campus bell towers as five hundred graduating students march in procession.
panels.prose_en: Pomp and Circumstance chimes softly from the campus bell towers as five hundred graduating students march in procession.
panels.prose_hi: Panch sau snatak chhatra juloos mein march kar rahe hain to parisar ke ghanti toweron se dhumdham aur paristhiti ki dhimi aawajen baj rahi han.

panels.shot: demon and human students in white and violet graduation caps throwing smiles
panels.action: Horned demon girls and human boys in matching violet graduation gowns walk arm in arm toward the amphitheater.
panels.prose_en: Horned demon girls and human boys in matching violet graduation gowns walk arm in arm toward the amphitheater.
panels.prose_hi: Matching baingani graduation gown mein seeng wali rakshas ladkiyan aur manav ladke emphitheater ki or haath mein haath dale chalte han.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking down at the students: his eyes welling with proud tears
panels.action: A single tear of pure fulfillment touches Ha-Jun's cheek: 'They will never have to know what a war feels like.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Inhe kabhi kisi war mein ladna nahi padega. This was the price of peace.

panels.prose_en: A single tear of pure fulfillment touches Ha-Jun's cheek: 'They will never have to know what a war feels like.'.
panels.prose_hi: Shuddh tripti ka ek aansu ha-jun ke gaal ko chhuta hai: 'unhen kabhi nahin janana hoga ki yudh kaisa lagta hai.'

panels.shot: tae-jun nodding firmly: 'and it was worth every single drop of blood.'
panels.action: Tae-Jun nods: 'Every single drop.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Har ek qatra worth tha.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun nods: 'Every single drop.'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun sir hilate han: 'har ek boond.'

panels.shot: min-jae opening the rooftop door waving frantically: 'it's time!!'
panels.action: Min-Jae pokes his head out: 'The curtains are rising! Ha-Jun, Tae-Jun, on stage now!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Curtains are up!! Let's go!!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae pokes his head out: 'The curtains are rising! Ha-Jun, Tae-Jun, on stage now!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ne apna sir bahar nikala: 'parde uth rahe han! ha-jun, taaye-jun, ab manch par!'

panels.shot: ha-jun and tae-jun straightening their jackets smiling at each other
panels.action: The two brothers adjust their collars, exchanging a knowing, unshakeable look of shared triumph.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Ready, Dean Kang?

panels.prose_en: The two brothers adjust their collars, exchanging a knowing, unshakeable look of shared triumph.
panels.prose_hi: Donon bhai apne collar ko samayojit karte han, sajha vijay ki ek jankar, atal nazar ka aadaan-pradan karte han.

panels.shot: tae-jun smiling back: 'born ready, Supreme Sovereign.'
panels.action: Tae-Jun smiles: 'Lead the way, Ha-Jun.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Chalo, Ha-Jun.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun smiles: 'Lead the way, Ha-Jun.'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun muskurata hai: 'rasta dikhao, ha-jun.'

panels.shot: the two brothers stepping through the stage curtains into blinding stage lights
panels.action: They step through velvet curtains onto the grand graduation stage, greeted by a wall of golden floodlights.
panels.prose_en: They step through velvet curtains onto the grand graduation stage, greeted by a wall of golden floodlights.
panels.prose_hi: Ve makhmali pardon ke madhyam se bhavya snatak manch par kadam rakhte han, jahan sunhari floodlight ki deewar unka swagat karti hai.

panels.shot: ten thousand people in the amphitheater rising in thunderous applause
panels.action: Ten thousand students, parents, diplomats, and demon chieftains rise to their feet in a deafening standing ovation.
panels.prose_en: Ten thousand students, parents, diplomats, and demon chieftains rise to their feet in a deafening standing ovation.
panels.prose_hi: Das hazar chhatra, mata-pita, rajnayik aur danav sardar gaganbhedi taaliyon ke saath apne pairon par khade ho jaate han.

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping up to the microphone podium overlooking the vast crowd
panels.action: Ha-Jun reaches the central microphone; the crowd falls completely silent, hanging on his every word.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun reaches the central microphone; the crowd falls completely silent, hanging on his every word.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun kendriya microphone tak pahunchta hai; bheed puri tarah se chup ho jaati hai aur uske har shabd par dhyan deti hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking out over the smiling faces of the graduating class
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks into the eyes of the young human and demon students, smiling with deep, radiant warmth.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks into the eyes of the young human and demon students, smiling with deep, radiant warmth.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun yuva manav aur rakshas chhatron ki aankhon mein dekhta hai, gahri, ujjwal garmjoshi ke saath muskurata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun delivering his keynote address with gentle authority
panels.action: Ha-Jun: 'Five years ago, we were told humans and demons were born to destroy each other. Today, you prove hate is a choice.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Nafrat ek choice thi. Aur humne mohabbat ko chuna.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun: 'Five years ago, we were told humans and demons were born to destroy each other. Today, you prove hate is a choice.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun: 'panch saal pahle, hamen bataya gaya tha ki manushya aur rakshas ek-dusre ko nasht karne ke liye paida hue the. aaj, aap sabit karte hain ki nafrat ek vikalp hai.'

panels.shot: ha-jun gesturing to his brother standing proudly beside him
panels.action: Ha-Jun: 'Peace was not bought with weapons. It was bought with brotherhood.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Shanti kisi talwar se nahi... Ek doosre ka haath thaamne se aati hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun: 'Peace was not bought with weapons. It was bought with brotherhood.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun: 'shanti hathiyaron se nahin kharidi jati. ise bhaichare se khareeda gaya tha.'

panels.shot: the five hundred graduating students throwing their caps into the sky
panels.action: Five hundred violet and white caps soar into the blue sky like a flock of peaceful doves.

dialogue.speaker: graduates
dialogue.text: WE ARE THE NEW WORLD!!

panels.prose_en: Five hundred violet and white caps soar into the blue sky like a flock of peaceful doves.
panels.prose_hi: Panch sau baingani aur safed topiyan shantipurna kabootaron ke jhund ki tarah neele aakash mein ud rahi han.

panels.shot: confetti and flower petals raining down over the stage and crowd
panels.action: Golden confetti and red rose petals shower down upon Ha-Jun, Tae-Jun, Min-Jae, Baek, and Kuro.
panels.prose_en: Golden confetti and red rose petals shower down upon Ha-Jun, Tae-Jun, Min-Jae, Baek, and Kuro.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun, taaye-jun, min-je, bak aur kuro par sunhari confeddi aur lal gulab ki pankhudiyan barasti han.

panels.shot: the brothers smiling as the curtain falls on chapter 102 cliffhanger
panels.action: Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun stand together in the center of the cheering world, ready for the final 103rd farewell!

dialogue.text: ONLY THE FINAL CHAPTER REMAINS. CHAPTER 103: BEYOND THE SOVEREIGN.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun stand together in the center of the cheering world, ready for the final 103rd farewell!.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun aur taaye-jun utsahi duniya ke kendra mein ek saath khade han, antim 103vin vidai ke liye taiyar han!
